Iron Constitution.name: Iron Constitution
Iron Constitution.description:
🪨 Your body has toughened: you shake off illness, cold and exhaustion and take a hit better.

🎯 Good for front-liners and anyone who works long, hard shifts.
📋 Requires level 24 and Endurance 14.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1
Iron Constitution.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's body has toughened through a long stretch of training, injury and recovery: they recover from illness quickly, handle heat and cold and absorb blows that would stagger others. Show it in a solid frame and quick recovery. Limits: it toughens the body, not the mind, and it does not resist Quirk effects that bypass the body.
